As soon as you have signal, call 911.
Call if you can, text if you can't. Some areas accept texts to 911, but a voice call is best.
Be ready to tell them where you are, as exactly as you can.
Tell them the phone number you're calling from.
Tell them what the emergency is.
Don't hang up until the call-taker tells you to.
Stop. Take a moment to calmly look at your situation.
If you have a map, compass or GPS, or can see landmarks, use them to try to work out where you are.
If it's safe, retrace your steps to get back to the route you planned.
If you can't safely find your way back, stay where you are.
Changing location will make it hard for searchers to find you. Move only if there is an immediate threat to life.
